containers.description: Comment cache. TTL 15 min. LRU-30 eviction via sorted set.
containers.name: redis_comments

containers.name: Article Databases

containers.description: Stores Comment rows (Pending / Approved / Rejected)
containers.name: db_comments

containers.description: Stores Draft rows
containers.name: db_drafts

containers.description: Stores ProfanityWord rows
containers.name: db_profanity

containers.description: Stores Subscriber rows (unique Email index)
containers.name: db_subscribers

containers.description: Feature flag server. Flag: subscriber_service_enabled
containers.name: FeatureHub

containers.description: Scrapes /metrics from services
containers.name: Prometheus

containers.description: Cache hit-ratio dashboards (port 3000)
containers.name: Grafana

components.description: Static class. Registers Minimal API routes: POST /articles, GET /articles?region, GET /articles/{id}?region, PUT /articles/{id}?region, DELETE /articles/{id}?region. Uses records CreateArticleRequest and UpdateArticleRequest.
components.name: ArticleEndpoints

components.description: Reads 8 regional connection strings from IConfiguration. CreateForRegion(Region) returns a scoped ArticleDbContext pointed at the correct PostgreSQL shard.
components.name: ArticleDbContextFactory

components.description: IConfiguration + ConnectionMultiplexer injected via constructor. List key: articles:{region}. Item key: article:{id}:{region}. Methods: GetArticlesAsync, SetArticlesAsync, GetArticleAsync, SetArticleAsync.
components.name: ArticleCache

components.description: BackgroundService. Connects to RabbitMQ on startup; declares articles queue. Deserialises ArticleMessage; extracts W3C traceparent for Jaeger. Calls ArticleDbContextFactory.CreateForRegion to persist; calls ArticleCache to invalidate.
components.name: ArticleQueueConsumer

components.description: BackgroundService. On startup and every 5 min calls WarmAllRegionsAsync: iterates all Region values, queries ArticleDbContextFactory, writes to ArticleCache with 10-min TTL.
components.name: ArticleCacheWarmer

containers.description: Consumes new articles from queue; serves reads with cache-aside. 3 replicas behind nginx.
containers.name: ArticleService

components.description: Static class. Routes: POST /comments (record CreateCommentRequest), GET /comments?articleId, DELETE /comments/{id}. Returns 202 Accepted when circuit breaker is open (comment saved as Pending).
components.name: CommentEndpoints

components.description: DbContext with DbSet<Comment>. Comment has: Id (Guid), ArticleId (Guid), Author, Content, Status (CommentStatus enum: Pending/Approved/Rejected), CreatedAt.
components.name: CommentDbContext

components.description: Per-articleId cache. Key: comments:{articleId}. LRU tracking via sorted set comments:lru scored by Unix timestamp; evicts oldest entry when count exceeds 30. Methods: GetCommentsAsync, SetCommentsAsync, InvalidateAsync.
components.name: CommentCache

relationships.description: IDatabase operations + sorted set for LRU

components.description: Typed HttpClient. CheckTextAsync(string text) POSTs to /check and returns CheckResult {bool ContainsProfanity, List<string> MatchedWords}. Polly circuit breaker: 50% failure ratio, min 3 calls, 30s sampling window, 15s break duration.
components.name: ProfanityServiceClient

components.description: BackgroundService. Every 30 s queries CommentDbContext for Status==Pending comments. Calls ProfanityServiceClient.CheckTextAsync; sets status to Approved or Rejected; saves changes.
components.name: PendingCommentProcessor

containers.description: Manages reader comments; moderates via ProfanityService with Polly circuit-breaker fault isolation.
containers.name: CommentService

components.description: Static class. Routes: POST /drafts, GET /drafts, GET /drafts/{id}, PUT /drafts/{id}, DELETE /drafts/{id}. Draft model: Id, Title, Content, Author, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt.
components.name: DraftEndpoints

components.description: DbContext with DbSet<Draft>. Draft entity mapped to drafts table.
components.name: DraftDbContext

containers.description: Manages publisher article drafts.
containers.name: DraftService

components.description: Route: POST /newsletters/send. Calls SubscriberServiceClient.GetSubscribersAsync(); iterates and dispatches newsletter to each. Returns 503 if circuit breaker is open.
components.name: NewsletterEndpoints

components.description: Typed HttpClient. GetSubscribersAsync() GETs /subscribers on SubscriberService; returns List<SubscriberMessage> {Id, Email, SubscribedAt}. Circuit breaker: 50% failure / 30s window / 15s break.
components.name: SubscriberServiceClient

components.description: BackgroundService. Connects to RabbitMQ; consumes from subscribers queue. Deserialises SubscriberMessage and logs the welcome-mail event.
components.name: SubscriberQueueConsumer

containers.description: Sends newsletters to all subscribers; consumes welcome-mail events from RabbitMQ.
containers.name: NewsletterService

components.description: Routes: POST /check (CheckRequest→CheckResponse {bool ContainsProfanity, List<string> MatchedWords}), GET /words, POST /words (AddWordRequest), DELETE /words/{word}. DB seeded with: badword, spam, hate.
components.name: ProfanityEndpoints

relationships.description: Query words; case-insensitive text check; add/delete

components.description: DbContext with DbSet<ProfanityWord>. ProfanityWord: int Id, string Word.
components.name: ProfanityDbContext

containers.description: Checks submitted text against a managed banned-word list. Called by CommentService.
containers.name: ProfanityService

components.description: Route: POST /publish (PublishRequest {Title, Content, Author, Region}). Builds ArticleMessage with new Guid. Calls ArticleQueuePublisher.Publish. Returns 202 with generated Id and Region.
components.name: PublisherEndpoints

components.description: Implements IDisposable. Constructor opens RabbitMQ connection and declares articles queue. Publish(ArticleMessage) serialises to JSON, injects W3C traceparent header via ActivitySource for end-to-end Jaeger trace linking.
components.name: ArticleQueuePublisher

containers.description: Accepts article submissions; enqueues asynchronously; returns 202 Accepted immediately.
containers.name: PublisherService

components.description: Routes: POST /subscribers (SubscribeRequest {Email}), DELETE /subscribers/{email}, GET /subscribers. POST adds Subscriber row and enqueues welcome-mail event.
components.name: SubscriberEndpoints

components.description: DbContext with DbSet<Subscriber>. Subscriber: Id (Guid), Email (unique index), SubscribedAt.
components.name: SubscriberDbContext

components.description: Implements IDisposable. Publish(Subscriber) serialises to JSON and publishes to RabbitMQ subscribers queue, triggering welcome-mail flow in NewsletterService.
components.name: SubscriberQueuePublisher

components.description: Runs on every request. Reads subscriber_service_enabled flag from FeatureHub SDK. Returns 503 Service Unavailable if flag is off. Fail-open: if FeatureHub is unreachable, proceeds normally.
components.name: FeatureHub Middleware

containers.description: Manages newsletter subscriptions. Feature-flag gated via FeatureHub.
containers.name: SubscriberService
